test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'INDIA' is written as 'KPFKC' and 'CHINA' is written as 'EJKPC'. How will 'JAPAN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘INDIA is written as KPFKC’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60ef2cbeae5437953fdc6d5d2e22f7336fad64efcaee51409646eb18af6e10a1.png] 

For, 'CHINA is written as EJKPC',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/422733505350eadc097133f9c22ca0f4346a9d8fc8fbe695baf5e3c722e02d1a.png] 

Similarly, for '**JAPAN**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f4ce93e91771abdad798363e4ef02658779b68561cbf770bbc6adfac32c4ec2.png] 

So, 'JAPAN' will be written as 'LCRCP'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
